skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basis of construction organization and planning activities, their relationship and applicability to development and real estate business.
Understand the role of quality control in construction projects, its impact on real estate product value and quality of life for users.
Understand current trends and practical applications of construction technologies.
Understand site preparation techniques including earthworks and foundation works.
Understand concrete and reinforced concrete construction techniques.
Understand project completion techniques including finishing and assembly installation.
Understand construction scheduling methods and techniques.
Understand construction site layout principles and methods.
Develop effective communication skills for teamwork and decision-making.
Understand and be able to develop plans and manage construction progress effectively.
Be equipped with social context awareness, independent thinking, teamwork, and personal responsibility.
Have a sense of responsibility, persistence, professionalism, and cooperation in solving emerging issues.
Recognize ethical standards, social responsibility, and the ability to analyze social and work environment contexts.
